benchflow_compatibility_adjustment: Used BenchFlow 0.6.5's vllm OpenAI-compatible provider with an explicit Paratera endpoint; no task, Skill, Gold, verifier, or package source changed.
dependency_network_adjustment: Docker build and runtime HTTP(S) traffic uses the host proxy at host.docker.internal:7897 because direct deb.debian.org package downloads timed out during the first retained infrastructure attempt.
agent_install_adjustment: The isolated BenchFlow 0.6.5 environment retries a complete uv bootstrap download up to eight times and validates its shell syntax before installing the same pinned OpenHands CLI.
proxy_startup_adjustment: The isolated LiteLLM proxy uses its bundled model cost map to avoid a startup dependency on raw.githubusercontent.com, and allows up to 600 seconds for proxy health after observed cold-start timeouts.
repair_transport: Chat Completions SSE, losslessly archived and reassembled before unchanged package adapter validation
repair_output_normalization: If the final text contains exactly one complete object with an edits array, extract that object; preserve the raw SSE and final response unchanged in transport_evidence.json.
execution_budget: Unmodified task.md agent/verifier timeouts and BenchFlow 0.6.5 defaults; identical for repairs and controls.
method_disclosure: Package-provided single-request Chat Completions repair adapter; not the iterative SkillAxe repair algorithm.
